feed_items.body: Starship heat shield and engines were reviewed and looked great.

feed_items.body: Ship 42 was lowered from Pad 2 for rollback to the production site.

feed_items.body: Ship 42 rested in the chopsticks after its mission.

feed_items.body: Starship entered a long coast phase around Earth.
